_comment: Tier-2: IncrementalUpdateStaticSmoothingScheme smooths Cauchy stress to the nodes in FinalizeSolutionStep and therefore needs the full dam_mechanical_solver nodal set — NODAL_AREA, NODAL_CAUCHY_STRESS_TENSOR, NODAL_JOINT_WIDTH, NODAL_JOINT_AREA — even for a purely mechanical static run. Pitfall (kratos.dam #4). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The scheme resolves on DamApplication. Its required variables straddle two modules: NODAL_AREA is core, while NODAL_CAUCHY_STRESS_TENSOR, NODAL_JOINT_WIDTH and NODAL_JOINT_AREA are PoromechanicsApplication attributes — not Dam's, and not core's. A user of a Dam scheme has to import Poromechanics to name three of the four. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
